name: Unassign task
description: Unassign task Deletes a specific task assignment. DELETE /2.0/task_assignments/{task_assignment_id}

name: Get task assignment
description: Get task assignment Retrieves information about a task assignment. GET /2.0/task_assignments/{task_assignment_id}

name: Assign task
description: Assign task Assigns a task to a user. POST /2.0/task_assignments
context:
POST /2.0/task_assignments
Assigns a task to a user. A task can be assigned to more than one user by creating multiple assignments.
Optional: body (body)

name: Update task assignment
description: Update task assignment Updates a task assignment. PUT /2.0/task_assignments/{task_assignment_id}
context:
PUT /2.0/task_assignments/{task_assignment_id}
Updates a task assignment. This endpoint can be used to update the state of a task assigned to a user.
Required: task_assignment_id (path) — The ID of the task assignment.
Optional: body (body)
